summary: Pre-deployment frontend E2E of 4 core flows + offline sync. RESULTS: Flow 1 Clock-in (PASS), Flow 2 Punch map desktop + mobile team map (PASS), Flow 3 Mobile leave request (FAIL — 422 + React crash), Flow 4 Mobile payslip view (PASS at /m/payslips; note request said '/m/pay' which redirects to marketing landing), Offline punch sync (PASS end-to-end incl. SW registration, IndexedDB queue toast+banner, drain on reconnect, no duplicate rows). Login smoke: email/password fields empty (prefill correctly removed for prod). Two frontend defects found — see critical bugs.

critical.issue: LeaveIn requires `employee_id` (Pydantic validation runs before the router's is_admin override), so the mobile form (which only sends leave_type/start_date/end_date/reason) always fails with 422. Either mark employee_id Optional[str]=None in models.LeaveIn OR have MobileLeave.jsx send employee_id (current user's employee_id).

minor.issue: Response contains duplicate period rows for sia.kallon (e.g. 2026-08 appears 3 times, 2027-02 twice, 2026-01 twice within first 20 rows) — 50 runs reported but many are duplicates. Likely duplicated payroll_runs rows for gov tenant seed, or endpoint missing DISTINCT/dedupe. Verify seed and/or add dedupe in endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || ...) passes the FastAPI 422 detail array of objects directly to sonner, triggering React runtime error: 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, url})'. Uncaught error breaks the SPA — after this, subsequent client-side nav to /m/payslips redirected to marketing '/'. Fix: coerce detail to string (e.g., Array.isArray(detail) ? detail.map(d=>d.msg).join(', ') : String(detail)).

integration_issues.issue: Backend 422 (missing employee_id in payload) → toast fails to render → React error overlay → SPA state corrupted (subsequent /m/payslips navigation loads marketing landing until manual reload).

Request NOT persisted (not in My requests).

Route displays [data-testid=mobile-payslips] list, first row [data-testid=mobile-payslip-row-2026-08] shows 'Gross SLE 8,322.50 · PAYE SLE 1,770.25 · Net SLE 6,244.75', download control [data-testid=mobile-payslip-download-2026-08] is present. API GET /api/payroll/my-payslips returned 200 twice.
verified_features.OFFLINE_PUNCH_SYNC: PASS — After 2 loads, sw.js reports active + controlled=true. context.set_offline(True); Clock in → header shows 'Offline' badge, banner '1 punch queued · Waiting for signal to sync automatically', toast 'Punch queued — will sync when you're back online'. context.set_offline(False) + wait 8s + reload → punch appears as real row (IN 03:47 AM · 0m from Ministry of Finance HQ). No duplicate rows (backend 15s idempotency + SW drain mutex worked).

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix POST /api/leave 422 for mobile employee flow — make employee_id Optional in models.LeaveIn (server already overrides for non-admins) OR patch MobileLeave.jsx LeaveForm.submit to send employee_id (from /auth/me or current user context).

CRITICAL: Harden MobileLeave.jsx error handling — coerce err.response.data.detail to string before toast.error to prevent React 'Objects are not valid as a React child' crashes when backend returns pydantic 422 arrays. Consider a shared apiErrorMessage(err) util (also check other mobile forms — MobileClock, MobileVouchers — for the same anti-pattern).
MINOR: /api/payroll/my-payslips for sia.kallon returns duplicate period entries (2026-08 x3, 2027-02 x2, etc.). Investigate seed data or add dedupe by (employee_id, period) in the endpoint.
DOC: Update deployment checklist — mobile payslip route is /m/payslips, not /m/pay. /m/pay currently falls through to marketing landing (no route match).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/models.py LeaveIn.employee_id being required forces every non-admin mobile client to also send it — violates least-surprise since the router later reassigns it from the JWT for non-admins. Make it Optional[str]=None.

MobileLeave.jsx line 337: toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Could not submit') — detail may be a list of pydantic errors. This pattern is common and dangerous; add a global apiErrorMessage() helper.
MobileClock queued banner + drain path work as documented (sw.js IndexedDB queue + _drainInFlight mutex + invalidateMobileApiCache); no duplication after online. Good.
Route registration: consider adding /m/pay as an alias of /m/payslips (many docs/tests refer to /m/pay) or return a 404 UI instead of silently falling through to the marketing landing.

rca of the issue: Flow 3 root cause: MobileLeave.jsx LeaveForm.submit posts {leave_type,start_date,end_date,reason} but backend models.LeaveIn declares employee_id as required (str, no default). FastAPI/Pydantic returns 422 before routers/leave.py:create_leave can override employee_id from the JWT for non-admins. The frontend catch block then calls toast.error(err.response.data.detail) where detail is an array of pydantic error objects, which sonner tries to render as a React child → 'Objects are not valid as a React child' overlay. Mitigation: (a) mark employee_id Optional in LeaveIn (backwards compatible — admins can still pass it), (b) stringify detail in MobileLeave catch (defensive).
